dispute_ticket.description: I took the lift down as soon as I saw the driver's message, I was barely 10 minutes behind. He cancelled and I got a S$6.00 no-show fee. Please refund me.

chat_logs.content: At Waterway Point drop-off bay, silver Prius.
finishing up in the lift, 1 min!
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $6.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-8101 booked trip RYDE-PX-001 to Seletar Mall. Pickup 14:20.
Driver pressed I'm Here; GPS 12 m from pickup pin.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event.
$6.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive: a wait of exactly this many minutes already meets it.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrival_time 14:20:00 to cancellation_time 14:30:00 is exactly 10 minutes. This trip's no_show_threshold_min is 10 and the policy text says the limit is inclusive, so the no-show stands. GPS shows the driver at the pin throughout and the rider's 14:27 message ('1 min!') shows she had not arrived. The S$6.00 fee is due.
